items.title: Update frequency and evidence framing: visibility vs. the boastful read
items.description: Priya's running doc updates people on her work some number of times a month. Each update can be framed mostly as evidence (facts, numbers, links — like her postmortem-style doc) or mostly as personal declaration (first-person claims about her own value — the 'loud declarer' failure mode). Drag both sliders: notice that raising frequency alone raises boastfulness risk fast, but raising the evidence share lets frequency climb while keeping that risk low.

params.name: evidenceShare
params.label: Share of each update that's evidence-framed (vs. personal declaration)

items.compute: const freq = params.updatesPerMonth; const evidence = params.evidenceShare / 100; const visibility = Math.min(100, freq * evidence * 12 + freq * (1 - evidence) * 6); const boastfulnessRisk = Math.min(100, freq * (1 - evidence) * 20); return { visibility, boastfulnessRisk };
